cases.description: Fillets on the four vertical edges only.

messages.content: Create a 40 by 30 by 12 mm box and round its four vertical edges with 3 mm fillets.

cases.description: Fillets around the top face of a plate.

messages.content: Create an 80 by 50 by 8 mm plate and fillet the four edges around its top face with a 2 mm radius.

cases.description: A fillet on one rim of a cylinder.

messages.content: Create a 30 mm diameter, 20 mm tall cylinder with a 2 mm fillet on its top rim edge only.

cases.description: Rounded plate corners plus a centre hole.

messages.content: Create a 70 by 40 by 5 mm plate with 6 mm rounded corners and a 10 mm hole through the centre.

cases.description: A boss that must sit on the plate.

messages.content: Create a 60 by 40 by 5 mm plate with a 10 mm diameter, 8 mm tall boss centred on top.

cases.description: Four standoffs with holes, joined to a base.

messages.content: Create an 80 by 60 by 4 mm base with four 8 mm diameter, 10 mm tall standoffs on top, each 10 mm in from two edges, and a 3 mm hole through the centre of each standoff and the base.

cases.description: A gusset that must join both legs of a bracket.

messages.content: Create an L-bracket 50 mm wide: a 30 mm deep, 5 mm thick base and a 5 mm thick upright along one long edge, 30 mm tall overall, with a 5 mm thick triangular gusset in the middle joining the base and the upright, 20 mm along each leg.

cases.description: A pin standing out of a block.

messages.content: Create a 30 by 30 by 20 mm block with a 6 mm diameter pin sticking 10 mm out of the centre of its top face.

cases.description: Walls measured from the base.

messages.content: Create a tray 80 by 50 mm outside with a 3 mm base and 12 mm tall walls, 2 mm thick.

cases.description: A stem measured from the top of its base.

messages.content: Create a knob with a 30 mm diameter, 8 mm tall base and a 15 mm diameter stem 12 mm tall on top of it.

cases.description: Walls measured from the floor.

messages.content: Create an open-top box 60 by 40 mm outside with a 4 mm floor and 3 mm thick walls that rise 20 mm from the floor.

cases.description: A lip measured from the underside of a lid.

messages.content: Create a 70 by 50 by 3 mm lid with a lip on its underside, 2 mm thick and 4 mm deep, set 1.5 mm in from the outer edge.

cases.description: Four corner holes.

messages.content: Create an 80 by 50 by 6 mm plate with four 4 mm through-holes, each 6 mm from two edges.

cases.description: Holes on a bolt circle around a centre bore.

messages.content: Create a 60 mm diameter, 5 mm thick disc with six 5 mm holes evenly spaced on a 44 mm bolt circle and a 20 mm hole in the centre.

cases.description: A centred grid of vent holes.

messages.content: Create a 100 by 60 by 3 mm panel with a centred 5 by 3 grid of 6 mm vent holes spaced 15 mm apart.

cases.description: Counterbored holes on a square.

messages.content: Create a 50 by 50 by 10 mm block with four counterbored holes on a 36 mm square: 4.5 mm through-holes with 8 mm diameter, 4 mm deep counterbores from the top.

cases.description: Thicken a plate and keep its holes and rounded corners.

messages.content: Change the plate thickness from 5 to 8 mm and change nothing else.

cases.current_code:
length, width, thickness = 70.0, 40.0, 5.0
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_offset = 15.0
corner_radius = 4.0
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(length, width, thickness)
    register_feature("plate", "Plate", "additive", part.part,
                     parameters={"length": length, "width": width, "thickness": thickness})
    fillet(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=corner_radius)
    register_feature("corner_fillets", "Corner fillets", "fillet", part.part,
                     parent_id="plate", parameters={"radius": corner_radius})
    with Locations((-(length / 2 - hole_offset), 0, 0), (length / 2 - hole_offset, 0, 0)):
        Hole(radius=hole_diameter / 2)
    register_feature("mounting_holes", "Mounting holes", "pattern", part.part,
                     parent_id="plate", parameters={"diameter": hole_diameter})
result = part.part
